::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/time_travel/advance"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to_time` | `string · ISO-8601` | **yes** | The time to move the clock to (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `step_days` | `integer` | no | The number of days per step when advancing the clock (1 to 366). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Time Travel state plus steps/from/to |
| `400` | Invalid body |
| `403` | Requires an all-mode API key |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/time_travel/advance" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "to_time": "2026-03-14T09:30:00Z"
  }'
```
